title: ～をはじめ — starting with ～ / ～ and others
summary: Gives one typical or leading example and implies that many others are included too: “starting with ～, (and others).” It follows a noun, and the second half talks about the whole group. It is a slightly formal expression.

patterns.form: 名詞＋をはじめ（として／とする）
patterns.gloss: noun + をはじめ + the whole group (社長をはじめ、社員全員)

body.p: In “A をはじめ B,” A is a typical example or the central person or thing, and B is the whole group including A (all the employees, various crops, and so on). 社長をはじめ、社員全員が参加した means “the president and all the other employees.”
Before a noun it becomes をはじめとする (社長をはじめとする社員), and before a verb you may also hear をはじめとして. B must be of the same kind as A. In 米をはじめ、さまざまな農作物, A is the most prominent item in the same group.

examples.ja: 社長（しゃちょう）をはじめ、社員（しゃいん）全員（ぜんいん）が参加（さんか）した。
examples.romaji: Shachō o hajime, shain zen'in ga sanka shita.
examples.tr: Everyone, starting with the president, participated.
examples.note: The president is the leading example.

examples.ja: この国（くに）には、米（こめ）をはじめ、さまざまな農作物（のうさくもつ）がある。
examples.romaji: Kono kuni ni wa, kome o hajime, samazama na nōsakubutsu ga aru.
examples.tr: This country has various crops, starting with rice.
examples.note: Rice is the most typical crop.

examples.ja: 両親（りょうしん）をはじめ、家族（かぞく）みんなが賛成（さんせい）してくれた。
examples.romaji: Ryōshin o hajime, kazoku minna ga sansei shite kureta.
examples.tr: My whole family, starting with my parents, agreed.
examples.note: Parents come first, then the rest of the family.

pitfalls: B must be of the same kind as A: × 社長をはじめ、机が壊れた.
To modify a noun use をはじめとする: 社長をはじめとする社員.
